paragraph: Granville’s composite prints a mildly constructive primary verdict of 56/100 with no active breadth divergence warning, pointing to an intact underlying trend despite mixed sub-signals. Market internals reflect a narrow advance rather than broad-based participation, as decisive outperformance in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +1.21%) and supportive volatility behavior effectively counter acute economic drag from transports (IYT/SPY -0.86%) and sluggish equal-weight breadth (RSP/SPY -0.34%). The macro backdrop remains a pillar of stability, anchored by tight high-yield credit spreads at 2.67%, quiescent implied volatility with the VIX at 16.26, and well-anchored 10-year real yields at 2.43%. However, subtle friction persists through a firming Japanese yen at ¥153.27 and lagging small-cap relative strength at 0.3816, signaling that risk appetite is selective rather than exuberant. Lean cautiously bullish into the open with a disciplined preference for large-cap tech leadership over broad cyclicals.
